summary: IDF conducts air strike on Hezbollah drone in Lebanese village under Israeli control. US attacks Panamanian ship linked to Iran. Iran claims increased missile range threatening European cities.
key_points: IDF launches air strike on Hezbollah drone in village under Israeli control in southern Lebanon (Source: @New_security8200/203267).
US military targets Panamanian ship associated with Iran, hitting rudder after warnings (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79129).
Iran asserts missile range expanded to 4,100 km, threatening European cities like London and Paris (Source: @kianmeli1/90805).
Trump emphasizes economic pressure on Iran, citing 300% inflation and currency devaluation (Source: @VahidOnline/77821).
US deploys over 1,500 Patriot missiles in response to Iranian attacks in Jordan (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384048).
IDF initiates covert operation to secure Hezbollah infrastructure in Lebanon (Source: @inon_yttach/9829).
Iran allegedly bypasses US defenses in Jordan using advanced rockets (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384048).

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's expanded missile range and alleged bypass of US defenses in Jordan pose significant regional threats. Economic pressure from US sanctions may not deter Iran, which continues military posturing. US military responses, including Patriot missile deployments, indicate escalating countermeasures.
sections.regional_response: US military actions in Gulf States and Lebanon reflect efforts to contain Iranian influence. IDF operations in Lebanon suggest coordinated efforts to disrupt Hezbollah capabilities. Iran's economic resilience and military advancements complicate diplomatic solutions.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iran's missile capabilities and economic strategies suggest a calculated approach to regional dominance. US reliance on economic pressure may be insufficient without coordinated Gulf cooperation. IDF operations in Lebanon highlight ongoing military tensions with Hezbollah.
